levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبة بن مسعود

notes: قال الأوزاعي is a link after Muhammad b. Harb (rule 5). Ubayy b. Kab is the last link: he is quoted as hearing the Prophet (rule 6), and Ibn Abbas is in the chain as the one who asks him. The Prophet is not a link; the kunya and the name after the comma are one man (أبو القاسم، خالد بن خلي).
